Services

Professional consulting services for healthcare organisations.

Consulting across four core areas — from business development and corporate relations to operational processes and the medical industry.

01

Business Development Consulting

Together we assess your organisation’s current position, strengths and growth potential, and turn business development goals into concrete steps.

  • Corporate business development processes

    Planning, prioritising and structuring business development activities within the organisation.

  • Assessment of business strategies

    Reviewing existing strategies against the organisation’s goals and sector conditions.

  • Research into new business opportunities

    Identifying new business areas, partnerships and opportunities that suit the organisation.

02

Corporate Relations Management

Lasting success in healthcare rests on reliable relationships with the right organisations. We approach your corporate communication and partnership processes from this perspective.

  • Corporate communication processes

    Reviewing the tone, channels and processes the organisation uses to communicate with stakeholders.

  • Partnership development

    Identifying partnerships aligned with your goals and structuring collaboration processes.

  • Managing corporate relationships

    Managing existing corporate relationships on a sustainable, mutually beneficial basis.

03

Operational Process Consulting

We assess organisations’ administrative and operational processes in terms of efficiency, quality of communication and institutional experience, and offer recommendations for improvement.

  • Analysis of patient admission processes

    Examining the administrative flow, workload and touchpoints at the admission stage.

  • Review of appointment and communication processes

    Evaluating the effectiveness of appointment scheduling and internal and external communication channels.

  • Recommendations for improving business processes

    Prioritised, practical improvement recommendations based on the needs identified.

04

Business Development in the Medical Industry

We support medical companies that work with healthcare organisations in understanding regional markets, strengthening their sales structure and developing key account relationships.

  • Regional market research

    Assessing healthcare organisations and market dynamics in the target region.

  • Sales organisation consulting

    Recommendations on the structure, processes and target planning of sales teams.

  • Key account relationships

    Developing long-term, trust-based relationships with healthcare organisations as clients.

  • Commercial business development

    Identifying new commercial opportunities, partnerships and areas for growth.

Who we work with

For stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our consulting services are designed for organisations and companies operating in the healthcare sector.

Private hospitals

Management teams seeking an outside perspective on growth, corporate relations and administrative processes.

Medical centres and clinics

Organisations looking to strengthen their structure and evaluate new opportunities.

Medical companies

Companies aiming to grow in regional markets and deepen relationships with healthcare organisations.

International partners

Organisations seeking professional partnerships within the Turkish healthcare sector.

About the scope of servicesOur consulting addresses the business and management processes of organisations. Medical diagnosis, treatment, patient referral and medical tourism brokerage are outside the scope of these services.
